name: trackiq-amazon-amc-media-mix
title: TrackIQ: Amazon AMC Media Mix
summary: A twelve-slide Amazon Marketing Cloud deck arguing one case — where the budget goes versus where new customers come from. Attribution paths, what DSP is worth alone versus in a path, cost per new customer by channel, time to purchase, and one reallocation with the arithmetic shown.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

fallback: Works from exported AMC attribution-path, NTB-by-campaign and time-to-conversion tables plus monthly spend by channel. Slides 3-10 build from pasted figures; slide 11 records which pulls were manual.
